# authwise_access_condition (Data Source)

A condition in an audience's Access catalog, which a binding can require. This data source reads one by its full resource name.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Full resource name of the object to read.

### Read-Only

- `audience_id` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `display_name` (String)
- `expression` (String)
- `issuer_id` (String)
- `tenant_id` (String)
